documents.title: MRPL Standard Operating Procedure: Centrifugal Pump P-101 Maintenance
documents.ai_description: Standard operating procedure detailing maintenance thresholds, vibration severity levels (ISO 10816 Zone B <= 4.5 mm/s RMS), bearing temperature caps (82°C / 180°F), and mechanical seal leakage criteria (Plan 53B) for refinery centrifugal pump P-101.

documents.title: MRPL Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-1) P&ID Standard Symbols Manual
documents.ai_description: Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-1) P&ID engineering manual defining instrumentation tags (PT-101, PT-102, FT-101), 100% duty-standby pump configurations, motorized isolation valves, and thermal overpressure relief setpoints (16.5 bar).

documents.title: API Standard 610: Centrifugal Pumps for Petroleum, Petrochemical and Natural Gas Industries
documents.ai_description: API Standard 610 specification covering hydraulic design requirements, preferred operating region (70%-120% BEP), minimum continuous stable flow (MCSF 30%), and 82°C hydrodynamic/rolling bearing thermal thresholds.

documents.title: Industrial Equipment Pressure Vessel Inspection Standards (API 510)
documents.ai_description: API 510 in-service inspection code for pressure vessels specifying non-destructive examination (NDE), 4-quadrant ultrasonic thickness inspection, and corrosion monitoring.

documents.title: MRPL SOP MECH 4.2 Centrifugal Pump Vibration & Overhaul
documents.ai_description: This document establishes vibration velocity thresholds, bearing temperature thresholds, and mechanical seal inspection criteria for API 610 centrifugal pumps in MRPL. It outlines permissible vibration limits, seal inspection requirements, and overhaul protocols.

documents.title: MRPL ESD-101 Valve Safety Standard
documents.ai_description: This document specifies that emergency shutdown valves (ESD-101) must close within 2.5 seconds upon activation of the High-High Pressure Alarm (PAHH-101).

documents.title: MRPL Flaring Manual
documents.ai_description: This document specifies the maximum smokeless flaring rate of 120 tons/hour and outlines process parameters for the MRPL refinery flaring system.
